verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a knowledge-base app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Logseq shipping a native AI assistant. Third-party marketplace plugins and the local HTTP API are developer building blocks or extensions, not the product's own assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
